items.t: Gulf Coast Traffic Alerts: October 27
items.x: Here are your traffic alerts for Tuesday, October 27.

items.t: Former true-crime producer accused of posing as aircraft heiress added to FBI most-wanted list
items.x: A 75-year-old woman who allegedly posed as an heiress to steal more than $14 million has been added to the FBI’s Most Wanted list.

items.t: Utah authorities connect serial killer Ted Bundy to another 1970s homicide
items.x: Serial killer Ted Bundy has been linked to another Utah teenager's 1974 murder through new DNA testing, prosecutor says

items.t: Flávio Bolsonaro heads to US following Brazil election loss despite ban from leaving country
items.x: Brazilian senator Flávio Bolsonaro has left Brazil and is headed to the U.S. after losing Sunday’s presidential election, two sources confirmed to CNN.

items.t: US military says 5 were killed by a strike on an alleged drug boat in the eastern Pacific
items.x: The U.S. military said it attacked a boat it accused of smuggling drugs in the Pacific Ocean Tuesday, killing five people, which brings the total death toll to at least 240 in more than 70 strikes.

items.t: Teenager charged in hit-and-run that killed 6-year-old getting off the bus
items.x: A 17-year-old was charged in connection with a hit-and-run that killed a 6-year-old girl in Charlotte last week, according to authorities.

items.t: Alex Pretti’s family says feds are still stonewalling efforts for justice
items.x: The parents of Alex Pretti, an American man shot and killed by ICE agents in Minneapolis in January, are accusing the DOJ of violating their rights.

items.t: Microsoft offers a quarter of its global workforce voluntary buyouts as AI spending accelerates
items.x: Microsoft is offering 60,000 employees, or about 27% of its global workforce, voluntary buyouts as the software giant spends heavily on artificial intelligence.

items.t: Marco Island suspends water consumption alerts due to software issue
items.x: Marco Island has suspended water consumption alerts after a technical problem caused invalid notifications about leaks and water usage spikes.

items.t: Missing woman reportedly found alive in Mexico, but her family has doubts
items.x: An Arizona woman missing since 2024 has been said to have been found in Mexico.

items.t: Aging Untold: Hospice doesn’t have to happen at home
items.x: On this episode of Aging Untold, we explore compassionate hospice care options beyond the home, focusing on comfort, dignity and family support. Plus, we share practical advice for older adults stepping up to raise school-aged kids and…

items.t: 1 dead in North Fort Myers mobile home fire
items.x: One person died in a North Fort Myers mobile home fire Tuesday morning.

items.t: 'Gulfcoasting' with Animal Refuge Center's four-legged residents
items.x: From forever homes to fundraising fun! Jason Drew visits ARC to meet the animals, learn about their lifesaving mission, and preview the Starlight Auction, one of the shelter’s biggest nights of the year.

items.t: Cornell student suspended after 2023 alleged assault was then placed in co-ed dorm, professor says
items.x: A Cornell student disciplined in connection with an alleged 2024 gang rape returned to campus this fall after a suspension and was placed in a co-ed dorm with a roommate who had no idea about his past, according to a professor.

items.t: The Exoneree Band: How a group of wrongfully convicted men found their voice through music
items.x: For the Exoneree band, music is a form of therapy, a way to process the unimaginable trauma of being stripped of their lives and liberty.

items.t: Punta Gorda Airport to host TSA PreCheck enrollment event Nov. 17-20
items.x: IDEMIA will conduct appointments in the Bailey Terminal baggage claim area.

items.t: FDOT holds public hearings on I-75 expansion plans on the Gulf Coast
items.x: FDOT is proposing improvements to a 21-mile stretch of I-75, including new lanes and noise walls, and is gathering public feedback through hearings.

items.t: ‘McMillan & Wife’ actress Susan Saint James dies at 80
items.x: Susan Saint James, the Emmy-winning actress known for “McMillan & Wife” and “Kate & Allie,” has died at 80, according to People.

items.t: Candy by the lake: 8th annual Trick or Treat on the Lake returns tonight
items.x: Suncoast View got an inside look at the setup for the 8th annual Trick or Treat on the Lake at Nathan Benderson Park

items.t: Suspect arrested in Instagram sextortion investigation 3 years after teen’s death
items.x: An arrest has been made in conncection to the death of an Ohio high school student who died by suicide after becoming a victim of sextortion.
